prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE two-state concept comparison sheet for a medical-room entrance in a hand-painted 2D factory/prison exploration game.
Input image 1: STYLE and CONTEXT reference only, the user's current in-game clinic screenshot. Generate a new concept sheet; do not modify the screenshot or reproduce its HUD.
Primary request: improve the door design so the clinic has a physically coherent DAY OPEN state and NIGHT CLOSED state. Replace the awkward tall outward-splayed hinged leaves with a compact double-leaf MANUAL SIDE-SLIDING steel clinic door. Old industrial infirmary styling, not a modern automatic hospital door.
Composition: TWO equal large side-by-side scene close-ups of EXACTLY the same clinic south entrance at EXACTLY the same camera angle, scale, doorway width and wall geometry. Left daytime open, right nighttime closed. Entrance and adjoining wall occupy most of each panel; a little interior floor visible above and pavement below. Both scenes use the game's orthographic slightly elevated 2D cutaway projection with horizontal/vertical world axes, no vanishing point and no isometric diagonals. Slim existing ivory coping, blue-grey trim, ivory plaster and sage glazed-tile skirt match reference. Keep the doorway at the same width relative to the adjoining wall, and include the two small existing planters beside the entrance to ground scale. No characters, HUD, joystick, quick slots, pursuit banners or surrounding whole map.
Door design identical across both states: two flat sage-green painted steel leaves, each with a modest rectangular pale blue frosted-glass upper panel and simple recessed black handpull near the meeting seam. Lower panels solid steel with understated framed edges, slim dark blue-grey frame, sensible small rollers and ONE neat thin overhead manual slide rail fixed to the wall and extending onto both side-wall segments. No electricity, sensors, glowing futuristic controls or accordion folds. Door bottoms align cleanly to the same flat ground threshold; no floating posts, outward protrusion, oblique door planes or giant bolts. The leaves slide sideways in the plane of the facade, not toward the camera.
LEFT scene: both leaves fully retracted along their respective side-wall faces, framing a WIDE unobstructed central opening at least a character-and-a-half wide. Clearly show the flush side-stowed leaves and simple rail, no leaves intruding into central walking area. Interior clinical tiled floor visible through the opening. Natural warm-neutral daylight.
RIGHT scene: the SAME leaves moved to meet at the centre, fully closing that exact opening. Visible neat central seam, recessed paired pulls, a modest mechanical latch. No residual gap, no passage through it. Restrained cool blue-grey night illumination outside and a soft warm interior glow diffused through frosted glass; enough light to clearly judge materials and closed state, not excessively dark.
Style: crisp readable hand-painted game art with dark fine outlines, muted aged enamel steel and clean modest wear; match the reference artwork, not photorealistic architecture. Thin tidy rail/frame, material continuity and sensible proportions are the main focus. The two views must look like usable open/closed sprites of one mechanism, not two different buildings.
Text only: small clear labels above the respective panels, exactly “白天 · 开放” and “夜间 · 关闭”. No other text, dimensions, arrows, logos, watermark or extra inset variants.
Output: clean polished concept comparison, landscape layout, discreet warm neutral border, high detail without noisy grunge.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, a two-panel concept of the SAME manual sliding clinic door at day and night.
Make ONE targeted mechanical-consistency correction to the LEFT DAYTIME OPEN panel only. The night/right panel is correct and must be kept unchanged.
The left/open leaves are currently drawn too narrow with small narrow glass slots, making them look edge-on or compressed. They are rigid side-sliding leaves and MUST retain exactly the same full frontal width, height, rectangular glass pane size, trim and proportions as the right/closed leaves. Widen each LEFT PANEL leaf to roughly the width of ONE right-panel closed leaf (about 150 image pixels), preserve its full height about 225 pixels. Both leaves remain completely front-facing and flush in the wall plane, never rotated or folded or compressed.
Place the left open leaf on the LEFT adjoining wall face at approximately x=115..265 and the right open leaf on the RIGHT adjoining wall face at approximately x=565..715, each running y=380..605 in the current 1536x1024 image. They must be slid outward so the central clear opening approximately x=265..565 remains completely free of doors. That clear opening must have the same width as the combined right closed leaves. Keep the existing thin top sliding track and move roller mounts to align with the relocated leaves. Make the left panel's frosted windows match the wide rectangular glass windows on the closed version, with neutral daylight glass instead of night glow. Mechanism is simple horizontal translation of unchanged panels.
Keep the label “白天 · 开放”, right label “夜间 · 关闭”, all night view details, daylight, building outline, camera, crop, plaster/tile palette, pavement grid, planter positions, painterly style and border unchanged. No characters, new objects or extra text. This correction must clearly show full-size doors stowed over side wall faces and a genuinely unobstructed aperture.
